origin.title: trivia night @ the rusty anchor
origin.text:
trivia ends around 10:30 so where do we go after
Slice Brothers is open late, i want pizza
we just had pizza last week tho
i could do the arcade at Pixel Palace, they have skee ball
pixel palace closes at 11 i think
it closes at midnight on thursdays i checked
ok so thats still a maybe
or bubble tea at Boba Haus, quick and cheap
boba is a vibe but i need real food
i vote pixel palace
pizza or arcade for me
boba haus for me, or arcade i guess
honestly no idea anymore, its a mess
ok muse do your thing
